The OTC bitcoin ETF GBTC offers investors a way to keep bitcoin in a retirement account if they have access to the over-the-counter markets. As some of you know, bitcoin carries significant risks in general. Some of the major cons with bitcoin and this particular ETF:

  • Bitcoin is highly volatile. People tend to buy and sell in the wrong times.
  • In its history, GBTC has almost always been overpriced relative to bitcoin. Because a person can get GBTC in their retirement account, it may be overpriced for this reason since the trader won't pay capital gains.
  • GBTC closes, while bitcoin never does. GBTC may not have time to react to a negative event.

The ETF does offer some diversification since bitcoin tends to be uncorrelated to other markets. If someone is willing to take the risk with a very small percent of wealth, they may find it beneficial only when it dips enough to buy. Unlike the SPY, investors should expect GBTC to see bigger dips than 3% when it does correct.
